Class ChallengeManager

java.lang.Object
ntnu.gruppe21.model.gameEngine.challenges.ChallengeManager
public class ChallengeManager extends Object
Challenge Manager contains and manages challenges. Is able to check if each challenge is completed and creates new challenge, and handles saving and parsing of said challenges.

To keep it simple, players will JUST HAVE ONE CHALLENGE, but this class definitely opens the possibility for multiple challenges. Tight coupling with player as certain challenges highly depend on players actions, for example starting money.

At the start, creates an empty set of challenges. Challenges need to be set after player creation: 1. use generateChallenges(Player) to create new random fresh challenges 2. when loading from a save, parseChallenges(Map, Player) is used in FilehandlerPlayer
